Lead summary:
- SMB, sells curated home + lifestyle goods (direct-to-consumer). ~120 employees, US HQ (Portland).
- Came in via blog post about best-practices for product Q&A; signed up for free hosted API trial. Wants fast time-to-value; no on-prem talk right now.
Use case specifics:
- Primary: product Q&A on PDPs and checkout (customers ask about materials, sizing, care). Expect lots of short queries (avg tokens small) but bursty spikes during drops and weekends.
- Secondary: catalog enrichment — auto-extract attributes (material, color variants, dimensions) from merchant CSV / vendor descriptions to improve filters and facet quality.
- Considering semantic rerank for search results using embeddings later; first priority is customer-facing Q&A.
Technical / perf requirements:
- Target p95 latency for Q&A ~<200ms; willing to accept streaming, prefer server-side client using SDK.
- Peak bursts: planning for up to ~1k concurrent QPS during product drops; baseline smaller. Cost sensitive: looking for guidance on batching, caching, and prefix caching to reduce tokens.
- Model preference: open to curated open models; wants ability to pin model version for consistency. No need for private deployment yet — public cloud hosted_api preferred.
Security / compliance:
- Minimal enterprise controls required now but asks for audit logs and retention controls (legal wants 1y logs). SSO/SAML TBD; SOC2 not required for now but they'd like list of certifications.
Commercials / adoption path:
- SMB procurement: small monthly budget for POC, possible upgrade to paid hosted API plan if latency + cost targets met. Estimated ARR small (12k-24k).
- Quote from Lila: "We need it to feel as fast as search — customers bounce if answers take >0.5s."
